verdict.rationale: Featurebase documents a programmatic surface that supports headless automation: an HTTP API and SDK reference, a Reports API, a Training Data API, and a find/replace help-center endpoint explicitly pitched for AI agents. Webhooks with signature verification and retries let backend systems react to events without the UI. However, the evidence shows no CLI, no CI integration or guide, and no published OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), so automation means hand-writing API calls. missing for 10: an official CLI or CI integration (e.g. a GitHub Action), documented CI/headless workflow guides, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration.
